notes:
# FMC Media PC 0.3.15

- Clicking Forward or Back no longer pauses the video when the controls are fading out. The controls stay up while the pointer rests on them.
- Right-click Forward or Back to choose how far it jumps (5, 10 or 30 seconds, or any time from 1 second to 2 minutes), separately for the button and arrow keys and for Shift + arrows. The jump length is shown inside the button.
- Up Next: a tab on the right edge opens every episode, season by season, with watched marks and progress. Play any episode, or restart the one playing.
- A new Up next card near the end of an episode shows the next episode's picture and name with a countdown, and plays it when the episode ends unless you dismiss it.
- The resolution (4K, 1440P, 1080P…) and HDR format (Dolby Vision, HDR10, HLG) appear next to the title.
- Download the video you are watching from the player. Settings → General → Downloads chooses between asking where to save each time and a default folder. Downloads resume if interrupted; streams split into many pieces (HLS/DASH) can't be saved as one file.
- Scroll the mouse wheel over the video to change the volume.
- The skip-time menu and Up Next panel use a black, see-through look.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
